purpose: Stage and independently review only inert conversion-root discovery and inode pinning for already-bound Local Mistral conversion authority.
requiredInvariants: This PR is inert and only pins the exact conversion-run directory identity. It does not read conversion-report bytes, model bytes or llama-server bytes; does not invoke Mistral; does not publish review/status; does not change verifier routing; and does not activate any workflow.

The caller must supply the exact-main SHA, workflow run id, workflow run attempt and conversion-root string already validated and bound by the admitted Local Mistral authority-binding segment; this primitive independently validates their canonical shape and exact derived-root equality but does not parse authority JSON itself.

Discovery starts from an O_PATH directory descriptor for / and descends only through the fixed literal components srv, tai-models and conversion-runs plus the strictly validated 40-hex exact-main component and positive-integer run-attempt component.

Every descendant directory is opened relative to its already-open parent descriptor with O_PATH, O_DIRECTORY, O_NOFOLLOW and O_CLOEXEC; no absolute authority pathname is passed to os.open and symlink final components fail closed.

Every accepted directory in the chain must be root-owned and must not be group- or world-writable, so the non-root reviewer/runtime identity cannot redirect the trusted directory chain after acceptance; root remains outside the untrusted review-input boundary.

The returned conversion-root descriptor remains open and pins the exact device/inode identity. All ancestor descriptors are closed before return. Downstream segment-8 must consume this descriptor directly rather than reopen the authority pathname.
The final conversion-root descriptor is re-fstat before return and its device/inode identity must match the identity observed at open time.
All operating-system failures are translated to fixed ConversionRootAuthorityError codes with suppressed exception chaining; raw filesystem details are not emitted by this primitive.
Literal child evidence/artifacts/toolchain/bin traversal and final report/model/server inode pinning remain segment-8 authority; byte/permission/size/digest verification remains segment-9 authority.

Report semantics, model/runtime semantic binding, execution from verified descriptors, sensitive-output handling, attestation publication, provider status, exact-head routing and self-review prevention remain separately governed.
No product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data or production-routing behavior is activated.
Local Qwen is the independent reviewer because this changes future Local Mistral authority only.
REG.RU remains production authority and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
